title: Indirect Connect Sole Handle Shortcut
description: Indirect connect: if a node has only one free eligible handle, skip ghost ring and treat as direct link (node-body hit starts wire; drop on target with sole compatible handle commits edge immediately).
summary: Indirect connect sole-handle shortcut: ghost ring only when a node has >1 eligible free handles; sole handle uses node-body hit (idle) and LinkTarget sole-body hit; pointer_up on a target with exactly one free compatible handle commits edge immediately (skip LinkTargetNode). Added helpers (eligible count, sole ids, point-in-node, node_sole_free_link_compatible_handle) and scene fixtures for two-free tests. Updated host tests for new UX.
